extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3 (RUN-2026-01 refresh, E18), following MKD-EU-2025-002. Multi-country Communication covering ten enlargement countries, with Annexes 1 to 6 (pages 31-62): only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, artificial intelligence, e-government, e-services, electronic, data protection, personal data, interoperability, broadband, 5G, gigabit, roaming, wallet, identification, trust services, online, ICT, internet, workers, social security, EURES, EHIC, labour, connectivity, technology) and full reading of sections I.2 security and resilience (pages 9-10), II (pages 11-19), III, IV and V (pages 19-30) including the North Macedonia paragraph (page 28). Annexes 1 to 4 (roadmaps for Montenegro, Albania, Moldova and Ukraine) do not concern North Macedonia; Annexes 5 and 6 have no in-scope indicators (the 'basic digital skills' rows are not linked to an in-scope recommendation, R2). Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one in the Communication and plus two in the annexes. Left out: cybercrime and misuse of new technologies by criminals (pages 8-9, R21); the Roam Like at Home extension to Ukraine and Moldova (page 14) and other passages only on Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Türkiye; SEPA (digital finance); the Common Regional Market's 'digitalising procedures' and general references to the green and digital transitions in the Growth Plan and IPA (incidental); digital skills (page 17). The North Macedonia paragraph in the conclusions (page 28) has no Chapter 2 or technology claim. Roam Like at Home (refresh plan, LIM-0037): the Communication says only that 'Work is advancing on extending the scheme to the Western Balkans' (item -0004); it does not repeat the Council's June 2026 authorisation of negotiations. The country report adds the Commission's February 2026 proposal (MKD-EU-2026-007, page 66). Second-pass check by a different agent (G3 condition 2 of GATE-0004): 2 items added (-0015, a general sentence split from -0011, and -0016, the horizontal passage on cybersecurity and interconnected networks, page 10), both theme_doubtful and out of scope; -0011 trimmed to one sentence; 14 first-pass items, yield 14 per hundred. See review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/MKD-EU-2026-009.csv.
